components.name: Carbon-film resistor
components.purpose: limits electric current and creates controlled voltage drops
components.symbol: a resistor zigzag or rectangle between two wires
components.behavior: electrical energy is changed into a small amount of heat as current is limited
components.safety: choose enough resistance and power rating for the circuit

components.name: Metal-film resistor
components.purpose: limits current with stable and accurate resistance
components.symbol: the standard resistor zigzag or rectangle symbol
components.behavior: a thin metal film resists charge flow and produces a predictable voltage drop
components.safety: do not exceed its power rating

components.name: Wirewound resistor
components.purpose: handles more power while limiting current
components.symbol: the standard resistor symbol, sometimes marked as wirewound
components.behavior: resistance wire turns electrical energy into heat
components.safety: it can become hot during normal use

components.name: Potentiometer
components.purpose: lets a user adjust resistance or divide a voltage
components.symbol: a resistor symbol touched by a movable arrow called the wiper
components.behavior: turning its shaft moves the wiper along a resistive track
components.safety: the wiper is a signal contact, not a high-power output

components.name: NTC thermistor
components.purpose: senses temperature because its resistance changes
components.symbol: a resistor symbol crossed by a temperature mark
components.behavior: its resistance decreases when its temperature rises
components.safety: self-heating can make a reading inaccurate

components.name: Photoresistor
components.purpose: senses light by changing resistance
components.symbol: a resistor inside a circle with arrows pointing toward it
components.behavior: more light usually lowers its resistance
components.safety: use a voltage divider to turn resistance into a readable voltage

components.name: Ceramic capacitor
components.purpose: stores a small charge and filters fast electrical noise
components.symbol: two equal parallel plates with a gap
components.behavior: it charges and discharges quickly and may be connected either way around
components.safety: stay below its voltage rating

components.name: Electrolytic capacitor
components.purpose: stores charge and smooths slower power-supply changes
components.symbol: two capacitor plates with a plus sign marking the positive side
components.behavior: it stores more charge than many similarly sized capacitors
components.safety: connect positive and negative terminals correctly

components.name: Tantalum capacitor
components.purpose: provides stable capacitance in a small package
components.symbol: a polarized capacitor symbol with its positive terminal marked
components.behavior: a tantalum dielectric stores charge in a compact part
components.safety: reverse voltage or excessive surge current can damage it

components.name: Film capacitor
components.purpose: stores charge with low loss and good stability
components.symbol: two equal capacitor plates with a gap
components.behavior: plastic film separates conducting layers that hold opposite charges
components.safety: choose a voltage rating above the circuit voltage

components.name: Supercapacitor
components.purpose: stores much more charge than an ordinary capacitor
components.symbol: a polarized capacitor symbol, often labelled with capacitance and polarity
components.behavior: it charges and discharges repeatedly between a capacitor and a small battery in behavior
components.safety: observe polarity and its low maximum cell voltage

components.name: Ferrite-core inductor
components.purpose: stores energy in a magnetic field and resists sudden current change
components.symbol: a row of curved wire loops
components.behavior: current through its coil builds a magnetic field in the ferrite core
components.safety: too much current can saturate the core or overheat the winding

components.name: Air-core inductor
components.purpose: stores magnetic energy without a magnetic core
components.symbol: a row of curved wire loops without core lines
components.behavior: its coil creates a magnetic field mostly through air
components.safety: nearby metal can change its behavior

components.name: Transformer
components.purpose: moves alternating-current energy between circuits and changes voltage
components.symbol: two coils facing each other, often with core lines between them
components.behavior: changing current in one coil creates a changing magnetic field that induces voltage in the other
components.safety: a transformer does not make unsafe mains voltage safe by itself

components.name: Cartridge fuse
components.purpose: opens a circuit when current stays dangerously high
components.symbol: a small rectangle placed in series with a wire
components.behavior: its thin internal link melts and stops current
components.safety: replace it only with the specified type and rating

components.name: Resettable fuse
components.purpose: reduces current when it becomes too hot from an overload
components.symbol: a resistor-like protection symbol commonly labelled PTC
components.behavior: its resistance rises sharply during an overload and falls after cooling
components.safety: it limits faults but is not a replacement for every safety fuse

components.name: Rectifier diode
components.purpose: allows current mainly in one direction
components.symbol: a diode triangle-like wedge shape pointing toward a straight bar
components.behavior: it conducts when forward biased and blocks most reverse current
components.safety: observe polarity and voltage and current ratings

components.name: Zener diode
components.purpose: holds an approximate voltage when used in reverse breakdown
components.symbol: a diode symbol with a bent cathode bar
components.behavior: it blocks reverse current until its Zener voltage is reached, then conducts
components.safety: use a series resistor to limit current

components.name: Schottky diode
components.purpose: passes current in one direction with a relatively small voltage drop
components.symbol: a diode symbol with a hooked cathode marking
components.behavior: a metal-semiconductor junction switches quickly
components.safety: check its reverse-voltage rating

components.name: Light-emitting diode
components.purpose: turns electrical energy into light
components.symbol: a diode symbol with two arrows pointing outward
components.behavior: forward current makes its semiconductor junction emit light
components.safety: use a current-limiting resistor and observe polarity

components.name: Photodiode
components.purpose: turns light into a small electrical current
components.symbol: a diode symbol with arrows pointing inward
components.behavior: incoming light creates charge carriers in its junction
components.safety: its signal is small and often needs an amplifier

components.name: NPN transistor
components.purpose: uses a small base current to control a larger collector current
components.symbol: a three-terminal transistor whose emitter arrow points outward
components.behavior: base current allows current to flow between collector and emitter
components.safety: limit base current and stay within voltage, current, and power ratings

components.name: PNP transistor
components.purpose: switches or amplifies using opposite polarities to an NPN transistor
components.symbol: a three-terminal transistor whose emitter arrow points inward
components.behavior: pulling its base below its emitter allows collector current
components.safety: check emitter, base, and collector orientation

components.name: N-channel MOSFET
components.purpose: uses gate voltage to control current between drain and source
components.symbol: a three-terminal field-effect transistor with an insulated gate
components.behavior: sufficient positive gate-to-source voltage forms a conducting channel
components.safety: protect the gate from static electricity and excessive voltage

components.name: P-channel MOSFET
components.purpose: switches a positive supply using gate voltage
components.symbol: a MOSFET symbol with the P-channel arrow direction
components.behavior: pulling the gate below the source turns its channel on
components.safety: check gate-to-source polarity and limits

components.name: IGBT
components.purpose: switches high voltage or current using an insulated control gate
components.symbol: a power transistor symbol combining MOS gate and bipolar output features
components.behavior: gate voltage controls a bipolar current path
components.safety: power switching needs correct gate drive, heat control, and protection

components.name: SPST switch
components.purpose: manually connects or disconnects one circuit path
components.symbol: two contacts with one movable line between them
components.behavior: closing joins the contacts; opening separates them
components.safety: use a switch rated for the circuit voltage and current

components.name: Momentary push button
components.purpose: changes a circuit only while it is being pressed
components.symbol: switch contacts with a push actuator mark
components.behavior: a spring returns its contacts when released
components.safety: microcontroller inputs may need pull-up or pull-down resistors

components.name: Electromagnetic relay
components.purpose: uses a coil signal to move separate switch contacts
components.symbol: a coil drawn beside mechanically linked contacts
components.behavior: coil current creates a magnetic field that pulls the contact arm
components.safety: a driver transistor and flyback diode are often needed for the coil

components.name: Optocoupler
components.purpose: passes a signal using light while keeping circuits electrically separated
components.symbol: an LED facing a light sensor inside one outline
components.behavior: the input LED shines on an internal phototransistor or photodiode
components.safety: maintain the required isolation spacing

components.name: Operational amplifier
components.purpose: amplifies the difference between two input voltages
components.symbol: a triangle with plus and minus inputs and one output
components.behavior: feedback makes it perform useful analogue operations
components.safety: inputs and output must stay within the device supply limits

components.name: Voltage comparator
components.purpose: reports which of two input voltages is higher
components.symbol: a triangle with plus and minus inputs and a digital-like output
components.behavior: its output changes state when the input order reverses
components.safety: some comparator outputs need a pull-up resistor

components.name: 555 timer
components.purpose: creates delays, pulses, or repeating oscillations
components.symbol: an eight-pin block commonly labelled 555
components.behavior: internal comparators watch a timing capacitor and switch the output
components.safety: connect reset and control pins as recommended for stable operation

components.name: 7805 voltage regulator
components.purpose: produces a regulated five-volt output from a higher input voltage
components.symbol: a three-pin regulator block marked input, ground, and output
components.behavior: it continuously adjusts an internal pass device to hold the output near five volts
components.safety: excess input voltage and current become heat

components.name: LM317 voltage regulator
components.purpose: produces an adjustable regulated output voltage
components.symbol: a three-pin block marked input, output, and adjust
components.behavior: two external resistors set the feedback voltage
components.safety: check dropout, heat, and resistor values

components.name: Buck converter
components.purpose: efficiently changes a higher direct voltage into a lower one
components.symbol: a switching power block associated with an inductor, diode or switches, and capacitor
components.behavior: rapid switching controls energy sent through an inductor to the output
components.safety: layout, current rating, and feedback wiring affect safe operation

components.name: Boost converter
components.purpose: changes a lower direct voltage into a higher one
components.symbol: a switching power block with an inductor and output diode or synchronous switch
components.behavior: an inductor stores energy and then releases it at a higher voltage
components.safety: the output can remain high after the input is removed

components.name: L298N motor controller
components.purpose: controls the direction and speed of two small direct-current motors
components.symbol: a multi-pin driver block with logic inputs and paired motor outputs
components.behavior: internal transistor bridges reverse motor current direction and PWM can adjust average power
components.safety: it loses voltage as heat and needs flyback protection and suitable cooling

components.name: AND gate
components.purpose: outputs one only when all required inputs are one
components.symbol: a flat-left, rounded-right logic-gate shape
components.behavior: it combines yes-or-no signals using the AND truth table
components.safety: unused digital inputs must not be left floating

components.name: NOT gate
components.purpose: outputs the opposite logic state from its input
components.symbol: a triangle with a small inversion circle on its output
components.behavior: a low input produces high output and a high input produces low output
components.safety: keep input voltage inside the logic-family limits

components.name: D flip-flop
components.purpose: stores one digital bit when triggered by a clock edge
components.symbol: a rectangular logic block with D, clock, Q, and often inverted-Q pins
components.behavior: on the active clock edge, the D input is copied to Q
components.safety: setup and hold timing must be respected

components.name: Microcontroller
components.purpose: runs instructions, reads inputs, and controls outputs
components.symbol: a rectangular integrated-circuit block with many named pins
components.behavior: its processor executes code while peripherals handle timing, communication, and signals
components.safety: power, ground, reset, and pin voltage limits must be correct

components.name: Quartz crystal
components.purpose: provides a stable oscillation frequency for clocks
components.symbol: a small rectangle between two capacitor-like plates
components.behavior: quartz mechanically vibrates at a precise resonant frequency
components.safety: use the specified load capacitors and short connections

components.name: Hall-effect sensor
components.purpose: detects a magnetic field and produces an electrical signal
components.symbol: a sensor block marked with magnetic-field direction or Hall notation
components.behavior: a magnetic field pushes charge sideways inside the sensing material
components.safety: orientation and magnet polarity affect the reading

components.name: Temperature sensor
components.purpose: turns temperature into a voltage, resistance, or digital reading
components.symbol: a sensor block associated with a thermometer mark
components.behavior: a temperature-sensitive element changes an electrical property
components.safety: place it where it measures the intended object rather than nearby heat

components.name: Ultrasonic distance sensor
components.purpose: measures distance using sound above human hearing
components.symbol: a sensor block with transmit and receive transducers
components.behavior: it times how long an ultrasonic echo takes to return
components.safety: soft or angled surfaces can produce weak echoes

components.name: Rotary encoder
components.purpose: reports turning direction and movement as pulses
components.symbol: a shaft or knob connected to two phase-shifted signal contacts
components.behavior: two outputs pulse in a sequence that reveals direction
components.safety: mechanical encoders usually need switch-debounce handling

components.name: Battery
components.purpose: provides direct voltage from stored chemical energy
components.symbol: alternating long and short parallel lines marked positive and negative
components.behavior: chemical reactions push charge through an external circuit
components.safety: avoid short circuits, reverse charging, puncture, and excessive heat

components.name: Board connector
components.purpose: joins power or signals between wires and circuit boards
components.symbol: a group of numbered contacts inside a connector outline
components.behavior: matching metal contacts make removable electrical paths
components.safety: verify pin order and orientation before applying power

components.name: Solderless breadboard
components.purpose: lets parts and jumper wires form temporary circuits without solder
components.symbol: it normally has no single circuit symbol because it is a construction tool
components.behavior: hidden metal clips connect groups of holes in rows and power rails
components.safety: power rails may be split and must be checked before use

components.name: DC motor
components.purpose: turns direct-current electrical energy into rotation
components.symbol: a circle marked M with two electrical terminals
components.behavior: current in coils interacts with magnetic fields to create torque
components.safety: use a driver and flyback path because a motor can draw high current and create voltage spikes

components.name: Servo motor
components.purpose: moves its shaft toward a commanded angle
components.symbol: a motor or actuator block with power, ground, and control connections
components.behavior: internal feedback compares shaft position with command pulses
components.safety: provide enough current and share the correct signal ground
